## Outcome

Describe the concrete result this issue should deliver.

## Context

Explain why it matters and what relevant behavior or content already exists.

## Scope

- Required capability
- Required integration points
- Required tests or documentation

## Non-goals

- Adjacent behavior that should remain unchanged
- Follow-up work that is intentionally deferred

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The intended public or contributor-facing behavior exists.
- [ ] Important edge cases are covered.
- [ ] Draft and unlisted content remain protected where relevant.
- [ ] Maintained documentation is accurate.
- [ ] Required checks and builds pass.
- [ ] The working-copy diff contains no unrelated changes.

## References

- Relevant pages, source files, documentation, or related issues

## Completion evidence

Record the delivered behavior, `jj` commit or change, verification results,
documentation updates, and follow-up issues before closing.
